summary: A BNP leader in Tangail's Mirzapur was removed from all positions after a video of him celebrating Brazil's football win went viral.
details: Khandakar Aminul Islam (Mintu), the president of Ward No. 1 of Gorai Union BNP, has been permanently expelled from the party.

headline: 271 patients hospitalized for dengue in 24 hours across Bangladesh
summary: No deaths were reported in the last 24 hours, but the DGHS reports a total of 6,871 cases this year.
details: According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Sunday, 271 new dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country in the last 24 hours.

The breakdown of admissions includes 63 people in Barishal and Khulna divisions respectively, 45 in Dhaka division (excluding city corporations), 30 in Chittagong division, and 30 in Dhaka South City Corporation.
Additionally, 27 patients were admitted in Dhaka North City Corporation, while seven were admitted in Mymensingh, four in Rajshahi, and two in Sylhet divisions.
The DGHS reports that 6,871 people have been infected with dengue this year, with 61.6% of the patients being male and 38.4% being female.
A total of 19 deaths have been recorded due to dengue fever this year, according to the health authorities.
caption:
271 new dengue patients hospitalized in just 24 hours. The surge continues across the country.

According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Sunday, 271 new dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country in the last 24 hours.

The breakdown of admissions includes 63 people in Barishal and Khulna divisions respectively, 45 in Dhaka division (excluding city corporations), 30 in Chittagong division, and 30 in Dhaka South City Corporation.

Additionally, 27 patients were admitted in Dhaka North City Corporation, while seven were admitted in Mymensingh, four in Rajshahi, and two in Sylhet divisions.

The DGHS reports that 6,871 people have been infected with dengue this year, with 61.6% of the patients being male and 38.4% being female.

A total of 19 deaths have been recorded due to dengue fever this year, according to the health authorities.

#Bangladesh #Dengue #HealthAlert #DGHS #PublicHealth

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
